[DB Instance: Redshift Retail]

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.order_status,
    o.customer_id,
    o.store_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.segment,
    c.region AS customer_region,
    s.store_name,
    s.city,
    s.region AS store_region,
    s.store_type,
    d.week_start_monday,
    d.month_start,
    d.quarter,
    d.year,
    d.fiscal_year,
    o.order_amount,
    o.discount_amount,
    o.shipping_amount,
    o.item_count
FROM analytics.retail.fact_orders o
JOIN analytics.retail.dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN analytics.retail.dim_store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
LEFT JOIN analytics.retail.dim_date d ON d.date_key = o.order_date
WHERE o.order_status <> 'Cancelled'
